smart_setup.no_script_title: Make sure the tracking script is installed
smart_setup.no_script_desc: The AI can suggest funnels and event rules based on your site, but they'll only collect data once the tracking script is active on your pages.

goal_select.title: What would you like to set up?
goal_select.subtitle: Choose a goal and we'll guide you through the right setup steps.

installation.title: Install Tracking Script
installation.description: Set up the Li2 Analytics script on your website step by step.

ai_setup.title: AI Funnel Setup
ai_setup.description: Let AI analyze your site and suggest funnels & event rules automatically.

heatmap_guide.title: Heatmap & Click Map
heatmap_guide.description: Visualize where users click, move, and scroll on your pages.

session_guide.title: Session Recording
session_guide.description: Record and replay full user sessions to spot friction points.

wizard.title: Behavior Analytics Setup
wizard.subtitle: Follow these steps to start tracking user behavior on your website.
wizard.all_set_description: Behavior analytics is now active on your website. Start exploring your data.

step_site_url.title: Add Your Website
step_site_url.subtitle: Enter your site URL and choose how you'll install the tracking script.
step_site_url.invalid_url: Please enter a valid URL (e.g. https://example.com)
step_site_url.platform_hint: Enter your site URL above to choose a platform
step_site_url.platform_html_desc: Add a CDN script tag or install the npm package
step_site_url.platform_wordpress_desc: Install the Li2 Analytics plugin on your site

step_script_install.title: Install Tracking Script
step_script_install.subtitle: Add the script to your website. Choose the method that matches your stack.
step_script_install.html_hint: Paste the snippet inside the <head> tag of every page you want to track.
step_script_install.wp_subtitle: Install the Li2 Analytics plugin on your WordPress site to start tracking.
step_script_install.wp_step_goto_upload: Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
step_script_install.wp_step_choose: Choose the downloaded .zip file and click Install Now

wp_configure.title: Configure Plugin
wp_configure.subtitle: Configure the Li2 plugin with your Publishable Key to start tracking behavior.
wp_configure.auto_desc: Click Auto Configure — we'll push your Publishable Key directly into the plugin.
wp_configure.popup_blocked: Popup was blocked. Please allow popups and click Auto Configure again.
wp_configure.window_closed: Window closed before configuration was applied
wp_configure.auto_fallback_prefix: If auto config doesn't work (popup blocked or plugin not yet activated), switch to the
wp_configure.manual_step2: Copy your Publishable Key and paste it into the plugin settings.
wp_configure.manual_step3: Click Save Settings in the plugin.

step_verify.title: Verify Installation
step_verify.subtitle: Open your site to confirm the script is correctly loaded.
step_verify.waiting_hint: Keep the site tab open — we'll detect the script automatically.
step_verify.no_url_hint: No site URL provided. Go back to step 1.
step_verify.empty_key: Key not set in the script
step_verify.success_msg: Script is active and correctly configured!
step_verify.skip_hint: Skip for now — you can verify from settings later.
step_verify.wp_subtitle: Open your site to confirm the Li2 Analytics plugin is active.

step_features.title: Choose Features to Track
step_features.subtitle: Select which behavioral events you want to capture. You can change these settings at any time.
step_features.pageview_tracking_desc: Automatically record each page visit and navigation event.
step_features.click_tracking_desc: Capture clicks on buttons, links, and interactive elements.
step_features.scroll_tracking_desc: Measure how far users scroll down your pages.
step_features.form_tracking_desc: Track form submissions, field focus, and abandonment.
step_features.outbound_tracking_desc: Automatically appends your click ID to outbound links so attribution carries through to the destination site.
step_features.outbound_domains_label: Track clicks to these external domains
step_features.outbound_empty: No domains added yet. Add at least one domain to track.
step_features.session_recording_desc: Replay user sessions to understand how they interact with your UI.
step_features.tracking_cookie_path_desc: Path scope for the tracking cookie. Use / for site-wide tracking.
step_features.tracking_cookie_domain_desc: Domain for the cookie. Use .example.com to share across subdomains.
step_features.tracking_session_timeout_desc: Inactivity duration before a new session is started. Minimum 60s.
step_features.tracking_cookie_expires_desc: How long the tracking cookie persists in the user's browser.

step_test.title: Test Your Setup
step_test.subtitle: Open your site and trigger a few actions to confirm events are being captured.
step_test.no_url_hint: No site URL — go back to step 1 to add your website.
step_test.actions_title: Try these actions on your site:
step_test.test_pageview: Navigate to a few pages on your site
step_test.test_click: Click on buttons, links, and interactive elements
step_test.test_form: Start filling out and submit a form
step_test.test_outbound: Click an outbound link and verify the click ID is appended to the destination URL
step_test.test_session: Browse the site for a few minutes to generate a session
step_test.debug_on: All SDK requests are being logged
step_test.debug_off: Turn on to start capturing behavior events
step_test.debug_warning: May contain sensitive data — disable in production
step_test.debug_empty: Enable debug mode above to start capturing events
